The Importance of DISP Accreditation for Australian Businesses
Jun 26, 2025
2 min read
What Is DISP?

Before you can pursue DISP accreditation, it's important to understand what the program involves and who it applies to. The Defence Industry Security Program (DISP) is managed by the Australian Government’s Defence Security and Vetting Service (DSVS). It is designed to protect Defence information and assets shared with industry partners.




DISP applies to companies across multiple sectors, including:

Engineering and advanced manufacturing

Cybersecurity and IT services

Consulting and project management

Construction and infrastructure

Education and research organisations

Environmental science and technology firms




DISP membership demonstrates your organisation's commitment to Defence security compliance and ensures that you can legally access, store, and work with sensitive Defence-related data.



Why DISP Compliance Is Crucial

Many businesses are unaware of how vital DISP compliance is until they miss out on a key opportunity. Here’s why it matters more than ever.




DISP is about much more than paperwork. Gaining DISP approval means your organisation:

Meets strict cybersecurity standards (aligned with ASD and ISM guidelines)

Has formalised governance frameworks

Follows best practice personnel security and vetting procedures

Maintains robust physical security controls




Failing to meet DISP requirements can result in being disqualified from Defence tenders or subcontracting opportunities—regardless of your capabilities.





How integPRO Supports Your DISP Journey

Achieving DISP accreditation can be complex—but you don’t have to do it alone. integPRO provides expert support from start to finish. 




At integPRO, we help businesses achieve and maintain DISP accreditation by offering tailored, end-to-end DISP consulting services.




Our team specializes in:

DISP gap analysis and risk assessment

DISP application preparation and documentation

Development of security policies and procedures

Cybersecurity hardening aligned with DISP standards

Employee vetting support and security awareness training

Ongoing DISP compliance and audit support




We've assisted organisations across Australia—from SMEs to prime contractors—in successfully gaining DISP membership and unlocking new growth opportunities in the defence supply chain.



Common DISP Accreditation Challenges We Solve

Most businesses encounter roadblocks when applying for DISP. Here are the most common issues we help our clients overcome.




Many businesses struggle with DISP due to:

Outdated or missing cybersecurity controls

Poor documentation of governance and risk management

Lack of employee vetting or background checks

Gaps in physical security measures

Unfamiliarity with DISP application requirements




integPRO simplifies the process by guiding you through every step, ensuring you're compliant, confident, and contract-ready.

✅ Deep expertise in DISP and integrated management systems  

✅ Proven success supporting clients in Defence and high-security sectors
